'''2012 European Championship Ben Smyth DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ben Smyth]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif}}
* '''Username:''' spambidextrous
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
